Observed summary KeyError on symlink records without sha256; fixed hashed-file comparison and added regression coverage. Fix is pushed; queued automatic run must regenerate the ranked gap report. No speculative fixes approved.

Guest boot acceptance now requires the actual AxionOS system fingerprint, API 36 and ARM64 uname, in addition to boot_completed and genuine PNGs. If a launcher lacks a system-image override, it must integrate the GSI into emulator super with verified tools or fail; generic default AOSP boot is never a pass.

Current stock init.otg.rc only sets OTG_CTL permissions; it supplies no paired property triggers. USB HAL init sets Type-C role-node ownership. No unproven always-on OTG service, SELinux bypass or guessed sysfs helper is delivered.

All 33 local regression tests and Python/shell syntax checks passed. GitHub safety checks for commit 1d524fe also passed; later safety runs and the firmware workflow continue independently. A newer x86-host/ARM64-guest pipeline run is queued behind the active older workflow.

Preserve debug.stagefright.c2inputsurface=-1. AOSP commit 1858832 documents application-side encoder input surface creation reducing per-frame IPC; no causal evidence justifies undoing this base behavior.

Approved scope is limited to an inert experimental manual Type-C root helper using stock HAL-exposed, standard port_type ABI. This is NOT a proven mouse-enumeration fix or full hardware compatibility. No guessed OTG_CTL writes, SELinux bypasses, persistent properties, startup scripts or polling.

Extended TCG launcher budget beyond the old 300-second cutoff, and made stage caches track their own unresolved blockers rather than unrelated concurrent state changes. Manual-helper-only releases remain explicitly experimental/prerelease even if boot/UI later pass.

Supersede the older orchestration run if still active: its audit/build checkout predates the approved manual helper and cannot produce that candidate. Preserve all mirrored/audit assets and start the updated Actions pipeline. No verified boot result is discarded.
Removed now-invalid appended AVB footer from modified system image. No signing keys available; device-specific AVB handling remains mandatory. Stock boot/vendor_boot untouched.

Supplemental Actions evidence confirms base VNDK 31 APEX container and existing Transsion OTG_CTL property handler. No redundant VNDK transplant or guessed gate patch approved. Potential fingerprint/USB recovery guard weakness is documented as a hypothesis, not a confirmed cause; base startup behavior preserved pending runtime evidence.

Candidates now select system_a preferentially and fall back to system, enabling the lpadd super-image override.

Fixed Ubuntu 24.04 noble package compatibility in emulator host prerequisites: removed obsolete libgl1-mesa-glx dummy package, installed libgl1/libglx-mesa0/libgl1-mesa-dri/libpulse0, and added resilient group creation for kvm/cvdnetwork/render.

Fixed QEMU vhost-vsock permission denied failure (modprobe vhost_vsock, chmod 666 /dev/vhost-vsock, vhost_user_vsock flag), added CVD process monitoring to terminate polling immediately upon unexpected exit, and eliminated Release upload 400/422 errors for 0-byte log artifacts.

Extracted and decompiled stock KL5 GKI 5.10.209 base DTB and DTBO overlay (dtbo_0.dts). Discovered primary charger IC is sc-swchg@6b (SGM41516D / SC8950) controlling regulator usb-otg-vbus (regulator.45) and Transsion tran_otg controlling GPIO 178 (otg_gpio_high/low).

Disassembled tran_otg.ko and reverse-engineered store_OTG_CTL. Confirmed store_OTG_CTL is strictly edge-triggered (returns immediately if requested value equals cached value). Prior attempts writing 1 failed because OTG_CTL was already 1. Deterministic fix: edge-trigger 0 -> 1 with 100ms settle delay, which invokes tran_otg_enable_vbus(1), setting 5.0V/1.2A boost, driving GPIO 178 HIGH, and asserting regulator usb-otg-vbus.

Created flashable Magisk/KernelSU module kl5_otg_fix (kl5-otg-fix.zip) with executable /system/bin/otg supporting subcommands on, off, status, debug, KernelSU action.sh toggle button, customize.sh permission enforcement, safe service.sh, and comprehensive diagnostic report generator saving to /sdcard/Download/otg-debug.txt.
Built GitHub Actions workflow otg-build-release.yml and staged release otg-v1 containing kl5-otg-fix.zip, SHA256SUMS.txt, and evidence/OTG_FINDINGS.md.

decisions.topic: Stock partition selection for slot B
decisions.decision: Flash verified physical A/B partitions (boot, vendor_boot, dtbo, vbmeta with disable flags, vbmeta_system, vbmeta_vendor, md1img, spmfw, scp, sspm, gz, lk, logo, tee, tkv) in bootloader fastboot, then reboot to fastbootd to flash logical partitions (system, vendor, product, system_ext, tr_*) extracted from stock super.img directly to _b partitions. Exclude all security/NVRAM/preloader partitions.

decisions.topic: No init_boot partition in stock ROM
decisions.decision: Confirmed via scatter file MT6768_Android_scatter.txt that init_boot has file_name NONE and is_download false. Ramdisk resides in boot.img (1.38 MB ramdisk verified in boot header v4). For root, Magisk must patch stock boot.img, not init_boot.img.

decisions.topic: Windows Batch format and strict CMD constraints
decisions.decision: All Windows scripts use pure ASCII encoding, CRLF newlines, no BOM, %~dp0 directory anchoring, and setlocal EnableDelayedExpansion. Zero external dependencies; certutil and copy /b used for reassembly and verification.

decisions.topic: GSI logical partition management in fastbootd
decisions.decision: Axion 2.9 GSI bundles system, product, and system_ext code in /system. Stock product_b and system_ext_b are deleted in fastbootd to prevent HiOS overlay conflicts and free 3.87 GB of space in main_b.
